evidence: Changes src/net_processing.cpp to drop transactions upfront at the deserialization stage if they have zero inputs/outputs or exceed block weight limits, mitigating network-level memory exhaustion.
rationale: Mitigates a severe P2P message-handling DoS vector where peers can send blocks or transactions with millions of tiny witness elements that allocate over 100 MiB of memory during deserialization. Author benchmarks show deserialized block memory dropping from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB, directly addressing resource accounting vulnerabilities on the wire.
